tools.Name: OpenMontage
tools.Description: An agentic video production system that uses AI to automate scripting, asset generation, editing, and final composition.
tools.Use_Case: Creating professional-grade videos from scratch, such as explainers, documentaries, and trailers, using AI orchestration.

tools.Name: VoiceStudio
tools.Description: A fully local alternative to hosted voice services for cloning, dubbing, and audiobook creation with support for 646 languages.
tools.Use_Case: Generating high-quality, private voice synthesis and video dubbing locally without account or API dependency.

tools.Name: Agent Reach
tools.Description: A tool that equips AI agents with capabilities to browse and search the internet, including Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, and GitHub.
tools.Use_Case: Enabling AI agents to perform real-time research, data gathering, and interaction across multiple online platforms without API fees.
